Product Features

  • Discover our exquisite TV cabinet, which shines in dark wood with a fascinating grey wood grain for a timeless elegance. With the generous dimensions of 200x40x55.5cm, this cabinet not only offers enough space for your 90-inch TV, but also practical storage space and a stunning design element for your living room.
  • Two cabinet doors on each side of the TV stand provide ample space for your media and accessories. In the middle is a fold-down glass door and an open storage compartment, ideal for your favorite décor items or media devices.
  • Particularly outstanding is the fold-down door made of Changhong glass in the middle. This unique feature allows you to conveniently control your consumer electronics without having to open the door. It adds a modern touch to your living room while protecting your devices from dust and scratches.
  • The TV cabinet has been designed with practical handling in mind. On the back, you'll find pre-installed cable management openings to keep your cables neatly and neatly organized. No more annoying cable clutter!
  • With this TV cabinet you will give your living room an upscale touch. The unique combination of materials and thoughtful design make it an excellent choice for your entertainment needs.
  • The tabletop of the TV stand features a unique gray design and grain that makes it stand out from other tables on the market and gives your home a unique look.
  • Please note: This product comes in 2 packages, please make sure you receive both packages before assembling it!
